L246: After recent releases from the US Census Bureau, the US Bureau of Labor Statistics, the US Bureau of Economic Analysis, the National Association of Realtors, and the Treasury's Bureau of the Fiscal Service, the nowcasts of first-quarter real gross private domestic investment growth and real government expenditures growth increased from 6.8 percent and 1.5 percent, respectively, to 8.9 percent and 1.8 percent, while the nowcast of the contribution of net exports to first-quarter real GDP growth increased from -0.50 percentage points to -0.32 percentage points.
L247: The next GDPNow update is Friday, March 13. Please see the "Release Dates" tab for a list of upcoming releases.

L252: ## March 02, 2026
L253: The GDPNow model estimate for real GDP growth (seasonally adjusted annual rate) in the first quarter of 2026 is 3.0 percent on March 2, unchanged from February 27 after rounding. After this morning’s Manufacturing ISM Report on Business from the Institute for Supply Management, the nowcasts of first-quarter real personal consumption expenditures on goods growth and real private fixed investment growth decreased from 1.5 percent and 3.6 percent, respectively, to 1.4 percent and 3.5 percent.
